## Handoff checkpoint — 2026-10-08

Execution is stopped at the user's request. All workers are settled; active R1 runtime, SSH and fetch commands joined; Linux111's R1 reservation is genuinely released. **Resume from the [durable handoff guide and evidence packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md)**, then refresh live heads, dependencies, reviews/CI and host ownership. The guide contains exact source branches, failures, source-only acceptance, unexecuted checks, preserved evidence and the restart order. Earlier checkpoint status below is historical. No product or performance acceptance is implied, and this ticket remains open.

**This node:** [allocator draft #5123](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5123) at46e5c249 and [composed draft #5122](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5122) preserve overlapping continuations. Resume #5103/#5105 -> #5108 plus the #5113 constructor prerequisite before final retirement qualification. The 184 top-level/330 named normal/race controls accept only the historical membership component; complete pre-WAL output, joint fit, scan/fence/economics and foreground plateau remain open. Integrate exact owner-ledger membership, reused IDs and forward-only uncertainty without a shadow allocator or highwater substitute.

Required allocation-representation successor #5103 is now adopted from retained b57 source/profile evidence and may land atomically with this PR. All existing cost/noise/foreground/rollout obligations remain required; this does not select a compressed-prefix format or accept the current publication amplification.

> Execution contract extension: canonical manifests in the existing system-root COW tree, new format only, with explicit engine-exclusive index ownership. See the accepted v2 comment below. Legacy standalone safeguards remain intact; bounded allocator pruning and honest internal-page versus file-deletion accounting are required. No runtime or performance acceptance yet.

## Accepted execution contract v2 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is1000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Goal and current proven bottleneck

Replace repeated global inventory plus whole-call locking in immutable leaf-manifest revision GC with a resumable protocol that bounds each step's work and writer/snapshot fence. Primary deliverable: **PR** after accepted [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) authority/scheduling decision.

[gcLeafManifestRevisions](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a/TreeDB/db/leaf_manifest_revision_gc.go#L21) holds `writeMu` and `rootReuseMu` across the whole explicit call. The store retains at most 16 selected delete handles but [rescans](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a/TreeDB/db/leaf_manifest_revision_gc.go#L95) the entire directory for each batch, giving documented O(N²/16) worst-case inventory work. Existing footprint limits reset per scan and are not cumulative work/time budgets. Descriptor bound (18 GC child descriptors) must remain distinct from work/pause/retained-memory bounds.

## Recommended redesign and required authority proof

Separate validated immutable inventory/scheduling from short authoritative retirement steps inside the existing manifest store and RecoverableRootSet/resource framework. A resumable cursor/epoch may schedule candidates, but cannot authorize deletion. Aim for one inventory per valid epoch plus candidate-local checks, with finite manifest-byte/entry/candidate/work budgets and cancellation/progress reporting. Resume work across calls; changes may invalidate or conservatively rebuild scheduling. Report invalidation/restart work under contention explicitly; near-linear work within a valid epoch is not an unconditional linear worst-case claim.

Capture/revalidate fresh recoverable roots, both durable slots, visible/queued resource debt and held-view generation pins at each authoritative step. Retain fresh exact live child handles through stable deletion and directory sync. Revalidate parent namespace, current revision, immutable contents and relevant publication/pin changes under the shortest correct fence. Inventory digest/name alone never grants deletion authority. [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) must prove how corrupt/rebound/unseen entries are rejected without restoring an entire global scan before every deletion batch; if that proof needs a store-minted inventory epoch or existing registry generation, its validity/invalidations must be explicit.

Do not add a second GC registry, delete by age, weaken later-inventory failure handling, lose quarantine/recovery-required semantics or let bounded handle count justify unbounded RAM. Existing snapshot admission may need a short per-step synchronized pin check; moving work out of locks is acceptable only with stale/revalidation proof.

## Ownership boundary and test-first

This packet owns **immutable leaf manifest revisions**, not #5015 raw-leaf resource projection, #5016 certified recovery membership/retained value-log pruning, #4878 MVCC version pruning or #1954 general typed-asset management. Consume relevant merged proof primitives where needed. Active value-log append retention has its own attributed owner selected by [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091); it is not fixed by deleting manifests.

Start from `leaf_manifest_revision_gc_5066_test.go`, `leaf_manifest_revision_gc_fd_linux_test.go` and recovery/root-set fixtures. Add a failing work-count test over many revisions and a deterministic bounded-step/cancellation/resume test. Cover new snapshot pins/publication between steps, both recovery slots, ABA/rebound parent/child, malformed/unseen inventory entries, partial progress, directory-sync/quarantine failures and shutdown. Preserve held-old/current rows and source identities through reopen.

## Structural and measured exits

- [ ] Inventory work within a valid epoch scales near one census plus candidate work, rather than full inventory times deletion batches; exact work counts over revision ladders prove it. Contended invalidation/restart scenarios must meet the finite step budgets and expose extra work honestly.
- [ ] Each step has finite cumulative work/retained-memory/descriptor admission and cancellation/resume; completed versus deferred/protected debt is explicit.
- [ ] Writer/snapshot fence covers only the validated authority/retirement interval; large inventories do not hold it throughout scanning. Measure wait/hold and concurrent foreground p95/p99.
- [ ] All corruption/stale/pin/dual-meta/stable-deletion proofs pass; no premature reclamation.
- [ ] [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) step/scan/pause budgets and comparative cost objective pass, with real deletion and WAL-excluded metadata-byte trajectories.
- [ ] Update `r1-row-lifecycle.md`, `recoverable-root-set-maintenance-3681.md`, `value-log-lifecycle.md`, concurrency, verification and maintenance guides in the PR.

Do not invent an unlimited storage plateau: demonstrate supported revision/segment counts, rollover and pin-drain behavior, with explicit residual retention attribution.


## Shared execution contract

Parent: [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090). Planning base: `b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a`; recheck affected production paths and owners before implementation. Read the parent's semantic, performance, documentation and reassessment contract.

This is a **performance-objective** packet. Prove the real public caller → eligibility → optimized primitive → fallback, with path/work counters; helper-only timings are insufficient. First capture the named invariant failing for the intended reason, or record a justified characterization exception for a behavior-preserving refactor. Run affected races, recovery/reopen and fault tests. Compare identical before/after commands and equivalent returned data, visibility, ownership and durable ACKs; report latency/throughput, B/op, allocs/op, setup/first-use, retained/peak memory and relevant storage/I/O/work counters. Charge allocations by row/request/batch/setup, and account for backing capacity and pins. Minimize avoidable copies/temporary representations before completion.

[#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) freezes the workload, numeric objective/budgets and noise policy **before candidate measurements**, from phase-attributed baselines. A pass requires the structural gate below and a repeatable material improvement beyond that policy; no-regression alone does not pass. If improvement is insufficient, profile and revise this packet or map a blocking replacement before final qualification. Unexplained material regressions block; an accepted necessary residual needs evidence, alternatives and explicit acceptance.

Use an isolated topic branch and PR; preserve unrelated work. Current repository policy requires a PR and strict current-head `TreeDB required gate`; the required formal-approval count is zero. Refresh rules before merge. Request credit-consuming AI review only for mature code/tests/performance evidence/docs, resolve findings, and repeat only for changed evidence. No execution or merge is performed by publishing these issues.



## Execution reassessment: private allocator preparation

Fresh current-main result retains all40 full oracles, all numerical GC/fence targets and only1/4 fixed noise groups passing. Setup allocation remains19.43/19.20 times control, and concurrent512 ACKp95 is18.0% slower with admitted noise: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5095#issuecomment-6041311772. No performance acceptance.

Selected necessary predecessor #5105 owns transaction-private first-write allocator preparation, preserving separate visible/seal generations, exact pages/CRC/reservations, rollback and pin/reuse horizons. It may land atomically with #5103/#5095. The allocation diagnostic and source-bound adviser justify the discriminating experiment, not a forecast or target waiver. Broad #5044 and external #5015/#5016/PR#5037 stay independently owned. All original foreground/noise/storage/rollout and full H/E gates remain required.


## Constructor prerequisite selected — 2026-10-08, 08:28 UTC

Required final acceptance/merge prerequisite: [#5113](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5113), the same-Pager constructor resident account, complete shared loans, pre-WAL capacity envelope and joined teardown. The historical Pager is born before the former first-request master, so attaching a request factory cannot certify its backing. Component construction can continue provisionally; full finite/native admission and this node's final runtime acceptance require #5113 accepted and merged with actual producer/retained-lifetime census and unchanged whole128MiB fit. No larger cap, default change, first-request reattribution, second budget/registry or external unfrozen ABI.
